description: Analyzes student study behavior and classifies their learning patterns

behavior_types.description: You maintain a strong and consistent study routine. You rarely miss deadlines and your performance is steady.
behavior_types.advice: Keep your momentum but remember to take breaks. Try tackling harder subjects during your peak energy hours.

behavior_types.description: You are most productive during late hours. Your focus peaks at night but mornings can be challenging.
behavior_types.advice: Protect your sleep schedule. Plan important tasks for your peak hours but ensure at least 7 hours of sleep.

behavior_types.description: You tend to work in intense bursts close to deadlines. While you get things done, this creates unnecessary stress.
behavior_types.advice: Break large tasks into smaller daily chunks. Use the 2-day rule: start any task at least 2 days before the deadline.

behavior_types.description: You thrive in collaborative environments and learn best when interacting with peers.
behavior_types.advice: Balance group study with individual review sessions. Join study groups that match your course load.

behavior_types.description: Your study activity is below the recommended level. You may be facing challenges that need attention.
behavior_types.advice: Start with just 30 minutes of focused study daily. Set one small goal each day and gradually increase your commitment.

traits: Mix of group and solo study
behavior_types.description: You maintain a healthy balance between studying, socializing, and rest. Your approach is sustainable.
behavior_types.advice: Consider optimizing your peak study hours. Try the Pomodoro technique to maximize your existing study time.
